phase: Reference Mode Recovery — Sectoral Financial Positions / Phase B exact aggregate identity
scientific_interpretation: The exact aggregate identity route resolves the Phase A source-coverage problem without converting any missing F2-F8 component to zero.
All mandatory total-F and mandatory-F1 sources are available, while the eight unavailable series are exactly the preregistered optional H/C F1 series and therefore do not count as source failures.
The resulting six-sector stock and flow histories contain 45 common quarters and all 2025 quarters.
Financial transactions reconcile within the preregistered 0.1 million RON tolerance for every common quarter.
Stock reconciliation fails the preregistered fixed tolerance in three quarters, so Phase B cannot promote the mode even though the maximum discrepancy is small relative to the series scale.
The fixed 0.1 million RON threshold may not be relaxed post hoc.

next_justified_path.condition: Only a separately preregistered rule derived from source metadata, not from observed Phase B residual magnitudes, may assess whether the stock discrepancies are fully explained by published rounding precision.
next_justified_path.allowed_metadata: ECB SDMX DECIMALS and UNIT_MULT attributes from the relevant source series.
next_justified_path.forbidden: Choosing a new fixed tolerance from the observed 0.165390625 million RON maximum residual.
